matches.rationale: No finding addresses the concatenation/decomposition equation in Section 2.1 (the sum of unimodal + cross-modal updates); all findings focus on Section 2.2.2's attention scaling or Section 2.2.4's linearity claim, not this specific equation.

Finding 3 identifies exactly the defect in the cross-attention normalizer: the claim that 'd is the dimensionality of the projected token embeddings' is inconsistent with the actual r-dimensional projected tokens, which is the same locus and substance as the GT's point about misapplied scaling dimensionality.
No finding discusses the specific B·0 vs 0 inconsistency in Eq. (13)'s cross-modal term for text tokens; Finding 2 raises a different issue (linearity/parameterization of ΔW) in the same section.

pred_verdicts.rationale: Raises a plausible shape-mismatch issue in the attention equations (N_a vs N_t under column convention) that is not among the listed GT corruptions.
Identifies a genuine linearity/parameterization concern about ΔW in Section 2.2.4, but this is a different specific defect than the B·0 inconsistency in GT3.
Correctly flags the inconsistency between the claimed normalizer dimensionality d and the actual projected-token dimension r, matching GT2's locus and substance.
